manage.lead: Counsel on iris colour before starting.

points: Check for alopecia areata, blepharitis, thyroid disease, trichotillomania.
Apply to the upper lid margin as licensed; effects over weeks to months.

rx.note: Permanent iris darkening possible; periocular pigment reverses.

items.t: Lash loss with scalp or brow loss, or lid disease: GP/dermatology/ophthalmology.
Eye pain, redness or visual change on treatment.

quiz.a: Periocular skin darkening and the lash growth.
Loss of eyelashes or eyebrows, which may signal disease.
